section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participant recruitment and selection process for a single study, starting with 143 college women and narrowing down to a final sample of 92 females after exclusions. It provides demographic information for this sample, including a mean age of 19.7 years, an ethnic breakdown with 50% Caucasian participants, and a mean self-reported BMI of 22.62.
